culprit_citations.quoted_text: Total investments, at fair value (amortized cost of $ 328,400 and $ 363,547 , respectively) | 342,015 | 409,665

findings.detail: The affiliate subtotal row carries $99.945 million of fair value and appears immediately before the filing's $342.015 million Total Investments row, so treating it as an indexable holding overstates the schedule against the source anchor.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate reconciliation. The filing's schedule total and balance-sheet anchor both report total investments at fair value of $342.015 million, while the extracted/indexable holdings sum is $437.923 million. The source therefore supports an over-coverage error. The localized schedule structure shows a non-position subtotal row, Total Affiliate Investments, with $99.945 million fair value directly above Total Investments; this subtotal is a source-grounded culprit for the over-coverage rather than a valid holding.
